description: This file contains C++ source code implementing JavaScript bindings for AAMP in WebKit browser, including functions to load, unload, and set HTTP headers for JavaScript contexts in web frames.

methods.name: CanInjectJSBindings
methods.description: Checks if JavaScript bindings can be injected into the given WKURLRef based on the hostname.

methods.name: LoadJSBindings
methods.description: Loads JavaScript bindings into the main frame of a WebKit WKBundleFrame if eligible.

methods.name: UnloadJSBindings
methods.description: Unloads JavaScript bindings from the main frame of a WebKit WKBundleFrame if previously injected.

methods.name: SetHttpHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers JSON string for the AAMP plugin.
